svg.title: HiFi assembly workflow: quality-control evidence
svg.desc: Connected quality-control schematic for the selected hifiasm and LJA branches. HiFi reads feed NanoPlot and TeloSearchLR; pooled HiFi and both Illumina mates feed KMC and exploratory GenomeScope2 fits. Raw and final core assemblies feed BUSCO, reference-free QUAST, Illumina-k-mer Merqury, and reference-based Chromeister. Additional haplotig Chromeister comparisons are manual targets. Final assemblies and Illumina reads produce matching BAMs; nQuire selects one preferred final BAM per sample. Optional TIDK and depth-callable diploid-model heterozygosity have separate inputs and outputs. Heterozygosity also uses OATK mito FASTA for sequence-verified mitochondrial exclusion. Barrnap is restricted to pre-mito hifiasm. Aggregate QC has defined metric sources; MultiQC is an independent dashboard of supported native reports. MGA is outside these core QC branches.

g.text: Exact inputs, explicit assembly stages and independent complementary analyses.
Each selected hifiasm / LJA assembly · raw and final
Model fits do not establish ploidy; repeat candidates do not establish T2T.
MGA remains a separate first-phase candidate outside these hifiasm / LJA QC branches.
